original_criteria.criterion: Verify proportional enzyme and substrate transfer before comparing rates.
Compare fractional loss from each post-split starting amount, not equal absolute gas amounts.

forecast: If enzyme and substrate transfer proportionally, both portions retain the same concentrations and should show similar fractional peroxide depletion, while absolute consumption scales with volume.
limitation: The enzyme is an effective surrogate and must remain dissolved; unresolved phase transfer makes the comparison inconclusive.
scope: Evaluate proportional dissolved enzyme/substrate transfer and actual fractional loss. A zero/zero post-depletion comparison cannot demonstrate fractional reaction-rate scaling. No altered dose, wait, floor or new runtime.
